Field Definition: The current status of the payout

AI Summary: The payout is in progress — awaiting bank or scheme processing.

Field Definition: The current status of the payout
Value Definition: The payout was successfully delivered to the destination card. Applies to card payouts.
AI Summary: The payout was successfully delivered to the cardholder's card.

Field Definition: The current status of the payout
Value Definition: The payout was approved and funds have been dispatched to the destination bank account. Applies to bank payouts.

Field Definition: The current status of the payout
